title: Mixed Event — The Sounds of a Summer Festival! — Episode2 Summer Festival Invite

meta.Event: The Sounds of a Summer Festival!
meta.Event Outline: Akito and Toya are invited to perform at the Summer Festival's live concert as a substitute act. Back when Akito had lost sight of his goals after facing setbacks in soccer, he and Ena witnessed that very same event...

rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: I don't think we even need to tally scores here. The BAD DOGS win! Talk about an awesome song...!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Hey, give us one more!
You gotta give us an encore!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah! Just one more!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Looks like you've made some friends, BAD DOGS. What do you say, you two?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Why not?
We've still got plenty left in the tank too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see no problem with that.
Let's keep singing for as long as we can.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Alright, BAD DOGS, give us an encore!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You guys, that was such an amazing show! The whole place was shaking because of all the cheering!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it was a good show, but we can't let that get to our heads...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right.
We still have plenty of room for improvement.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <What?! Really?! You guys can relax a little now, right? Aren't you guys not practicing for a while either?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <An said she's busy with stuff at home, and Kohane's gone off to that seaside school or something, so I feel like you guys can have some fun...>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Look, they're not skipping practice because they want to. We even said that we'd get right back to it once we can.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, which is why we shouldn't let our guard down just because Azusawa and Shiraishi aren't here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You guys are so cool. That means I need to try harder too...>

E-Excuse me...!
You're Akito Shinonome, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Len, mind hiding for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're...

Remember me?
I'm Shota Hayashi. We used to play on the same soccer team in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Sorry for being such a useless Ace.
Bye...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
W-Wait!
Akito, please don't quit...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember. It's been a while...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: I'm glad you're doing so well! We haven't talked at all since you quit playing soccer.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why are you here, anyway...?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Oh, right... I noticed you performing in that event just now and was wondering if I could ask you to do something...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? You want us to do something?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Yeah! I want you guys to perform in the live concert for the Summer Festival!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The live concert for the Summer Festival?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: It's called the Shibuya Summer Festival. Every year, we invite artists and performers to play in the concert...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, that festival.
Weren't there like pro and amateur divisions for that?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Yeah, looks like we're on the same page! I'm actually also a part of the planning committee this year.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You are?
How...?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: My brother's on the committee too, but he said that they needed more people. Then I ended up having to lead all the concert stuff...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: And we just found out that our headliner for the amateur division can't make it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So you were out looking for a replacement?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Exactly! Who would've thought I'd run into you like this, Akito...? You sounded amazing up there, so I'm sure you'd be able to make just a big a splash at the Summer Festival!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: So please, I need you guys to perform! I'm begging you...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
By the way, do you know who else will be performing?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Yes, of course! Here's a list of all the groups.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, hold up...
These guys are pretty much all dance teams.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Yes, this year we've primarily been inviting dance teams to perform in the amateur division.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sure you noticed during today's event that we're singers and not really dancers.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I hate to say this, but I'm not sure we'd fit into the overall theme you've established...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Everyone watching will want to see that sort of performance too, right?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: I completely understand how you feel...! But the headliner was also a singing group and not exactly a dance team.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Our schedule has the amateur division headliner go right before the pros take the stage.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: That's why we've reserved this slot just for someone that can really sing!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
S-So, how about it?
I'm sure you two would be able to handle it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm for participating in this event, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He gave a reasonable explanation as to why he picked us, complimented our singing ability and made it clear that he needs our help.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We even happen to be open just around the time of the festival too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Does that mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But since we're gonna be surrounded by dance teams, we should include a little of that in our performance, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We have ages to prepare for this concert of yours, but you think we'll be ready in time?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: No, you don't have to do that! We'd be more than happy with what you usually do...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It'll pretty much be just dance teams before us, right? We'd just be shortchanging the crowd if we get up there and don't dance at all.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's just like you to think that, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I have a feeling that our act will benefit from the addition of a few dance sequences, no?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We won't be able to practice singing as much, but it may help us down the road by learning to do something new like this...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Something new. Something other than singing... Somewhere new might be a nice change of pace too...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, we'll do it...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
What?! You will?!
Thanks! You're a lifesaver...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It looks like we have something to gain from this too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But again, we're not shortchanging the crowd. If we're gonna be the headliners, we've gotta sing AND dance.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
Reliable ol' Akito...
You haven't changed one bit since then.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Again, thanks. I'll do whatever I can to support you guys along the way too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, just make sure to tell us once you've got all the details worked out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And now we're performing in the Summer Festival...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'm looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You are?
Toya, does that mean you've...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I am genuinely excited about performing in this event and plan on doing everything I can to make it a success.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, it will also be my first time going to the Summer Festival, so I can't wait to see what it's like.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, fine. Whatever...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hey, can I come out now...?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you should be fine now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry about that, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<No, don't worry about it!
But since you guys are going to the Summer Festival now, can I come with you?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, but we're not going just to have fun.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I know!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But you're gonna be singing and dancing, right? So you'll be doing dance practices too?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yup.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Then, can I help you with that?
I even just got a new pair of shoes.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <They fit really nicely, so I'm thinking about turning them into my dancing shoes!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dancing shoes?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, I was told that it's good to have several pairs of shoes for when you're working on complicated dance sequences!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Like this!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I see. That's very cool.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I know, right?!
I was saying how my old shoes were getting worn out, and KAITO just ended up giving me a brand-new pair!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So that's what happened, huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then why don't we practice in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And shoes just for dancing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I never really thought about it, but can't we just use what we usually wear for this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've looked this up before and found that dancing shoes, such as ballet slippers, aren't necessarily made of anything special.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But it's also apparently good to choose them based on their lightness or purpose, such as if they can handle tough step sequences.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I doubt our current shoes will hinder us in any way, but it may be good to have a separate pair if we do plan on getting better.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Maybe...
I'm not trying to copy Len, but it would be a source of motivation too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wanna go check some out after practice?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yay!
Tell me once you're done, alright?
I can't wait to see what you get!>
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, wanna call it a day?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks for planning our after-party, Ena. It was really fun.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm glad you enjoyed yourself, Mizuki, but you're doing everything next time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Well, if I have time...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(There's still this divide between us...
Normally, I wouldn't have to go as far as saying that I'd plan one of these to get it off the ground...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I even promised myself to just wait and see...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, I'm going home now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... Bye.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot. I wanted to visit the CD shop on the way back, so I'll go with you until then, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's blocked...
They're doing construction.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're kidding. This whole road's blocked until the main intersection? I have to figure out a different way back..

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You know, it's sort of a scenic route, but wanna try going around and through that park over there? We can head straight for the station once we're out.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's pretty far and it's still hot out, but I guess we don't have much of a choice...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, you and Kanade don't get enough exercise anyway, right? It'll be good for you two.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You hardly look all that different from me, Mizuki. Don't put yourself up on a pedestal, alright?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, alright.
Anyway, let's go!
